your_book:
Wednesday was a split session for Jaleel's book — a handful of positions pulled their weight while the broader holding set gave ground. NVIDIA led the day, gaining 3.0% and reinforcing its thesis as AI-capex sentiment got a boost from CoreWeave and Cisco earnings commentary; Abbott added 1.1% on a quiet day, and Rocket Lab tacked on 1.5% despite carrying an AVOID verdict and a QARP score of just 39.6 — the lowest in the book by a wide margin. The overall book is sitting on an unrealized gain of 6.96%, but the day's breadth was notably negative.

The sharpest pain Wednesday came from Uber, off 4.1%, and Lululemon, down 3.8% — both meaningful weights and both already flagged. LULU is in outright loss territory (−5.5% unrealized) with a guidance-cut flag still live ahead of a September 2 print; the thesis is eroding with five straight negative Americas comp quarters. Zoetis slid 2.4% and sits at a −6.6% unrealized loss despite a STRONG BUY verdict and a top QARP score of 84.6 — that is a clean case of price and thesis diverging, and one worth watching closely. NBIX dropped 3.4% and is also underwater at −4.0%, while SAP gave back 2.6%.

The drift to watch most carefully is the RKLB position: it is the single largest weight at 16.0%, yet it carries the book's only AVOID verdict and its weakest QARP by far. Conviction and sizing are pointing in opposite directions. Separately, S&P Global's Microsoft AI-data collaboration announcement is a quiet positive for SPGI, which remains slightly underwater at −4.9% — worth monitoring whether that partnership narrative starts to move the stock ahead of the next catalyst.

attention.headline: Largest position carries an AVOID verdict and the book's lowest QARP (39.6)
attention.note: At 16% of the book, RKLB is outsized relative to every other holding and the fundamental scoring explicitly signals avoidance — size and conviction are in direct conflict, demanding a sizing review.

attention.headline: Down 3.8% today; −5.5% unrealized with guidance-cut flag still live
attention.note: Five consecutive negative Americas comp quarters, margin pressure from tariffs, and a September 2 earnings date mean the next catalyst could deepen the loss before any recovery — the BUY verdict needs to be stress-tested against the deteriorating fundamentals.

attention.headline: STRONG BUY / QARP 84.6 yet −6.6% unrealized and falling — thesis-price divergence widening
attention.note: Today's 2.4% drop extends an already negative position in the book's highest-conviction name by quality score; if the thesis is intact, this is an accumulation flag, but the divergence needs an explanation before acting.
